question: Omu n’ekibiina ky’abegyesa omu mashomero g’abaana abato nibaija kwetegereza omu mbeera za butoosha omugasho ogurikukurataho kuruga omu mutwe gw’okucweekereza eby’obutonde: “Kugamba aha bintu bikuru ebiri omu by’obutonde ebi barikucweekereza, nk’emibala, oburungo, obunene, obushushu n’ebindi.” Ni mbeera ki ey’abaana erikworeka ngu omugasho ogwo gutungwa?
answer_a: Omuhinguzi Santiago naabaasa kuta omwanya gw'okwega, naashushaniisa amabaare g'obunene obutari bumwe.
answer_b: Omuhimbo gw'emisana, Pablo areeba ekijiiko kandi yaareeba omushusho gwe naagira ati: "Reeba, Pablo!"
answer_c: Omu María omu kubanzaara, akoraaniza amataare g'emiti agari mushushani omu kashaaho.
answer_d: Omuhanda gw'okubungana omu rurembo, Soledad naaza aha mbuto omu mikono ye, yaagira ati: "Eziruma"

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omubanza ari kukora omurimo gw'ekibina gw'okukora aha bu умеgyezi bw'okucungura hamwe n'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi: "Kumanya eby'okukozesa n'omurimo gwabyo." Okutandika omurimo, naija kuha ekiina kyona omunana, orungyebwa, n'eppere, kandi naija kubagambira kunuunuza, kureeba, kukwata, n'okureeba buri kibala. Twahiriza aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, omurimo gwaha ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kuteekamu okukuraho abegyeswa bagonde ekigyendererwa ekyagambirweho?
answer_a: Omu omutabo ogurikugamba aha mitero y’ebibala, shaza eby’okugarukamu by’ebibuuzo ebirikubaasa kugarukwamu turikukoresa ebigyirizo: Ni kibala ki ekya ranga ya yellow? Ni kibala ki ekirikukoma? Ni kibala ki ekirikukwata kubi? Ni kibala ki ekirikunuunuuka gye?
answer_b: Omu rupapura orukubairemu emiringo erikubaasa kworekwa n'obumwe aha bw'obwengye (oburungi/obukali, oburagwa/omuchungwa, obworobi/obukomeezi, omunungo murungi/omunungo mubi), taangira ebijanjaara omu muringo egirikukuratira embeera ezi.
answer_c: Omu rupapura orukukwata aha mukoro ogurikworeka buri kamwe aha bwengye, shaza eby’okugarukamu by’ebibuuzo ebi: Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu ekitookye ni kiragura? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu epere ni nshumiire? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu ekishishwa ky’ekitookye ni kirerere? Ni bwengye ki obu orikukoresa kwetegyereza ngu omucungwa ni guhumba?
answer_d: Omu mweshomi ogurikworeka ebishushani by'ebijuma ebi, harimu emisingi erikukurira, ogumu gurimu akamwenyu n'ogundi gurimu obusaasi, shushani eby'okugarukamu byaawe aha bibuuzo ebi: Ku waaba noorya akacweka k'omucungwa, okahurira omuhindo gw'okushemererwa rundi ogw'obusaasi? Ku waaba nooreeba ibara ry'entege, okarikunda rundi torikukunda? Ku waaba nookora aha kikoba ky'epere, okahurira omuhindo gw'okushemererwa rundi ogw'obusaasi? Ku waaba noohumurira omucungwa, okagukunda rundi torikukunda?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi, omugyezibwa naayenda kworeka abegi emiringo etari emwe ey'okwaanya ebintu ebikwatiraine. Ahabw'ekyo, ayorekire abegi be ecupa erimu amaizi, amabaare, amajuta, n'omunyo. Omugyezibwa aine ecupa nyingi ezitebeekanisiibwe n'ebintu ebi bimwe. Aha mirimo ei erikukurataho, niki ekira kuleetera abegi kwega aha miringo y'okwaanya ebintu ebikwatiraine, kandi nabo nibakuzya obwengye bwabo omu kucungura obuhame bw'ebirikuruga omu kunoonyereza kw'obwomeezi?
answer_a: Omu mirwi, nibasharamu omuringo ogurikukiraho kubasa kw'ahukanisa emicwe n'obwo babihurikize ekyabaretere kwikiriza batyo.
answer_b: Omu omwe omwe, nibataana omutaano kurugiirira omu muringo gwona ogubasa kuba gubaire gusaaniire, kandi bashwijuma obwingana bw'okubaasa kukikora.
answer_c: Omwe-omwe, nibaha ebi barikuteekateeka aha muringo ogu bateekwa kukuratira, bagira omuringo ogw'omukago, reero bagutandika kukora.
answer_d: Omwe-omwe, nibakurata omuringo ogworekwa omwegyesa kw'ahukanisa emicwe n'okumanya oburyo bw'okwahukanisa obukozesibwe omuri buri omwe.
